verdict.rationale: Sentry Alerts explicitly support webhooks as an action alongside notifications/tickets/integrations (sentry-docs-21), and its MCP server plus Autofix/Seer automation give a clear path to have alerts trigger agent-driven remediation. However, there's no concrete documented example or independent confirmation of a webhook wired directly into an autonomous remediation/agent pipeline end-to-end. Missing for 10: a worked example connecting an alert webhook to an agent/remediation workflow, and independent/hands-on validation of this specific pattern.
